title: 1st Convocation Ceremony 2025 | KPGU
content: Governing Body, Board of Management, and Academic Council of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU) solicited gracious presence on the occasion of the 1st Convocation Ceremony. During the Convocation, degrees were conferred upon 1,496 graduating students from various academic programs. The ceremony witnessed the participation of more than 1,600 parents and invited guests, creating an atmosphere of pride, celebration, and academic accomplishment.
